questions.question: The polynomials ax³ + 3x² - 13 and 2x³ - 5x + a leave the same remainder when divided by (x - 2). Find the value of 'a'.
solutionSteps: Let P(x) = ax³ + 3x² - 13 and Q(x) = 2x³ - 5x + a.
By remainder theorem, Remainder 1 = P(2) and Remainder 2 = Q(2).

questions.question: Factorise completely: x³ + 13x² + 32x + 20
solutionSteps: Try x = -1: -1 + 13 - 32 + 20 = 0. So (x+1) is a factor.
Divide polynomial by (x+1) to get quadratic: x² + 12x + 20.

questions.question: If x + y + z = 1, xy + yz + zx = -1 and xyz = -1, find the value of x³ + y³ + z³.
solutionSteps: Identity: x³ + y³ + z³ - 3xyz = (x+y+z)(x² + y² + z² - (xy+yz+zx)).

questions.question: Without actual division, prove that 2x⁴ - 6x³ + 3x² + 3x - 2 is exactly divisible by x² - 3x + 2.
solutionSteps: We need to show P(1) = 0 and P(2) = 0.
Since P(1)=0 and P(2)=0, the polynomial is divisible by (x-1)(x-2).

questions.question: Simplify: (a² - b²)³ + (b² - c²)³ + (c² - a²)³ / (a - b)³ + (b - c)³ + (c - a)³
solutionSteps: Numerator is of form x³+y³+z³ where x+y+z=0. So it equals 3xyz.
Denominator is also of form p³+q³+r³ where p+q+r=0. So it equals 3pqr.
